lines.t: I was running on empty, lost in the noise,
Trying to fill every space with my own voice.
But when the silence hit, You called me near,
Your whisper broke through every doubt and fear.
I’ve been down, I’ve been broken,
But Your promise never fades—
Now I see the sun unspoken,
Through the cracks You made a way!
I will rise in the light,
Lift my hands to the sky,
You turned my pain into a song,
You made the weak feel strong!
When I stumble, You remind,
There’s a grace I can’t define—
I’m alive, I’m alive,
‘Cause Your love won’t say goodbye.
Every shadow runs when Your truth breaks through,
All the chains I wore now fall from view.
I don’t need the world to tell me who I am,
Your mercy’s written on my hands.
Even in the storm, I see Your flame,
Through the ashes, You still reign.
You’re the reason I keep singing loud—
I was lost, but now I’m found!
I will rise in the light,
Lift my soul to the fight,
You turned my fear into a song,
Your hope has been here all along!
When I fall, You’re by my side,
Every tear You sanctify—
I’m alive, I’m alive,
In Your love I’ll always rise.
In Your love I’ll always rise.
